$\Rightarrow \int_{-6}^{-2} f(x)\,dx = 7 - \left(11 - \frac{9\pi}{4}\right) = \frac{9\pi}{4} - 4$

(b) $\int_{3}^{5} (2f'(x) + 4)\,dx = 2\int_{3}^{5} f'(x)\,dx + \int_{3}^{4} 4\,dx$

$= 2(f(5) - f(3)) + 4(5 - 3)$

$= 2(0 - (3 - \sqrt{5})) + 8$

$= 2(-3 + \sqrt{5}) + 8 = 2 + 2\sqrt{5}$

— OR —

$\int_{3}^{5} (2f'(x) + 4)\,dx = [2f(x) + 4x]_{x=3}^{x=5}$

$= (2f(5) + 20) - (2f(3) + 12)$

$= (2 \cdot 0 + 20) - (2(3 - \sqrt{5}) + 12)$

$= 2 + 2\sqrt{5}$

(c) $g'(x) = f(x) = 0 \Rightarrow x = -1, x = \frac{1}{2}, x = 5$
